title: Tempero
introTitle: Tempero, just for the two of you
introText: An optional space for adults, with cards and desires for the couple. 18+ only.
partnerWantsText: The other person wanted to turn it on. It only starts when you turn it on too.
promises: It only counts when you both turn it on.
Either of you can turn it off any time, and everything disappears for both.
Your answers are only yours. Only what you both want shows.
A "not today" is never explained or announced.
waitingText: Nothing was announced. When they turn it on too, Tempero opens for both of you.
soloText: It needs two connected people. When the other person joins, it becomes available.

home.subtitle: Everything here is optional and stays between you.
home.desiresText: Answer in secret and see what you both want
home.challengeText: An invitation, with no points or deadline
